# [v70_mchain] Chain follow-ups consolidated into direct event chains.
# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.8 Worker 4: Religio Romana Storyline, Hexapantheon Swapper, Decisions & O(1) Pulse (oe_romp_, 0 slots, 0 rules, 0 GUI, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_romp_story.py; edit the generator, not this file.

on_game_start = {
    on_actions = {
        oe_romp_on_game_start
    }
}

on_religion_changed = {
    on_actions = {
        oe_romp_on_religion_changed
    }
}

monthly_country_pulse = {
    on_actions = {
        oe_romp_semiannual_pulse
    }
}

# Unconditionally ensure hellenism_has_omens = 1 regardless of D008 ownership or save entry.
oe_romp_on_game_start = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 }
    effect = {
        religion:hellenism_religion = {
            set_variable = {
                name = hellenism_has_omens
                value = 1
            }
        }
    }
}

# Ensure omen flag, purge unseated gods (6-god invariant), and trigger oe_romp.4 on first conversion to hellenism_religion.
oe_romp_on_religion_changed = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1200
        is_rebel_country = no
        exists = religion
        religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
    }
    effect = {
        religion:hellenism_religion = {
            set_variable = {
                name = hellenism_has_omens
                value = 1
            }
        }
        oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev4_fired } }
            set_variable = oe_romp_ev4_fired
            trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_romp.4 days = 1 }
        }
    }
}

# O(1) staggered pulse running strictly in April (month 4: storyline) and October (month 10: new deity boons).
# Rebel-guarded, exists=religion guarded, and restricted to hellenism_religion states or human BYZ/ROM pre-conversion.
oe_romp_semiannual_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1200
        is_rebel_country = no
        OR = {
            current_month = 4
            current_month = 10
        }
        exists = religion
        OR = {
            religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
            AND = {
                is_ai = no
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_rejected }
                OR = {
                    has_or_had_tag = BYZ
                    has_or_had_tag = ROM
                }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion }
            oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 4 }
            # --- Pre-conversion human-only Act I whispers ---
            if = {
                limit = {
                    is_ai = no
                    NOT = { religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion }
                    NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_rejected }
                    OR = {
                        has_or_had_tag = BYZ
                        has_or_had_tag = ROM
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev1_fired }
                        current_year >= 1355
                        current_year <= 1415
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev1_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.1
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev2_fired }
                        current_year >= 1410
                        current_year <= 1455
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev2_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.2
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev3_fired }
                        has_variable = oe_romp_ev2_fired
                        OR = {
                            owns = location:mount_athos
                            current_year >= 1420
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev3_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.3
                }
            }
            # --- Post-conversion 4-Act Religio Romana storyline (at most one event per April tick) ---
            else_if = {
                limit = { religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev4_fired }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev4_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.4
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev6_fired }
                        owns = location:constantinople
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev6_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.6
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev7_fired }
                        has_variable = oe_romp_ev6_fired
                        any_known_country = {
                            exists = religion
                            religion ?= { group = religion_group:christian }
                            is_great_power = yes
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev7_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.7
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev8_fired }
                        owns = location:athens
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev8_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.8
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev9_fired }
                        owns = location:rome
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev9_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.9
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev10_fired }
                        has_variable = oe_romp_unlocked_janus
                        at_war = no
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev10_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.10
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev11_fired }
                        current_year >= 1470
                        OR = {
                            owns = location:rome
                            owns = location:constantinople
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev11_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.11
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev12_fired }
                        OR = {
                            owns = location:salona
                            owns = location:pontikokastro
                            owns = location:mykonos
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev12_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.12
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev13_fired }
                        owns = location:alexandria
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev13_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.13
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev14_fired }
                        OR = {
                            owns = location:tarsus
                            owns = location:ankara
                            owns = location:tabriz
                            owns = location:isfahan
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev14_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.14
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev15_fired }
                        OR = {
                            owns = location:sivrihisar
                            owns = location:bergama
                            owns = location:smyrna
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev15_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.15
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev16_fired }
                        OR = {
                            owns = location:damala
                            owns = location:bergama
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev16_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.16
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev17_fired }
                        current_year >= 1580
                        OR = {
                            owns = location:kabul
                            owns = location:balkh
                            owns = location:lahore
                            owns = location:delhi
                            AND = {
                                has_variable = oe_romp_ev13_fired
                                current_year >= 1620
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev17_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.17
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev18_fired }
                        current_year >= 1580
                        OR = {
                            location:dadu = { has_owner = yes }
                            current_year >= 1640
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev18_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.18
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev19_fired }
                        OR = {
                            current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
                            has_embraced_institution = institution:scientific_revolution
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev19_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.19
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev20_fired }
                        current_year >= 1740
                        current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev20_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.20
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev21_fired }
                        OR = {
                            current_age = age_6_revolutions
                            has_embraced_institution = institution:enlightenment
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev21_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.21
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev22_fired }
                        current_age = age_6_revolutions
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev22_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.22
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev23_fired }
                        current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
                        owns = location:rome
                        owns = location:constantinople
                calc_true_if = {
                    amount >= 5
                    location:rome = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_capitolium }
                    location:athens = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_parthenon }
                    location:salona = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_delphi }
                    location:pontikokastro = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_olympia }
                    location:alexandria = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_serapeum }
                    location:ayasuluk = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_artemision }
                    location:constantinople = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_porphyry_sol }
                    location:mykonos = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_delos }
                    location:mystras = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_mystras_academy }
                }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev23_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.23
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev24_fired }
                        OR = {
                            current_year >= 1790
                            AND = {
                calc_true_if = {
                    amount >= 7
                    location:rome = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_capitolium }
                    location:athens = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_parthenon }
                    location:salona = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_delphi }
                    location:pontikokastro = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_olympia }
                    location:alexandria = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_serapeum }
                    location:ayasuluk = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_artemision }
                    location:constantinople = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_porphyry_sol }
                    location:mykonos = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_delos }
                    location:mystras = { owner ?= root has_building = building_type:oe_romp_temple_mystras_academy }
                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev24_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.24
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                current_month = 10
                religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_boon_cd }
                OR = {
                    has_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus
                    has_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno
                    has_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta
                    has_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius
                    has_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus
                    has_variable = oe_romp_seated_apollo
                    has_variable = oe_romp_seated_isis_serapis
                    has_variable = oe_romp_seated_quirinus_mars
                    has_variable = oe_romp_seated_mithras
                    has_variable = oe_romp_seated_cybele
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_romp_boon_cd years = 6 }
            random_list = {
                25 = {
                    trigger = {
                        OR = {
                            has_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus
                            has_variable = oe_romp_seated_apollo
                        }
                    }
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp_ritual.3
                }
                25 = {
                    trigger = {
                        OR = {
                            has_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno
                            has_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta
                            has_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus
                        }
                    }
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp_ritual.4
                }
                25 = {
                    trigger = {
                        has_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius
                    }
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp_ritual.5
                }
                25 = {
                    trigger = {
                        OR = {
                            has_variable = oe_romp_seated_quirinus_mars
                            has_variable = oe_romp_seated_isis_serapis
                            has_variable = oe_romp_seated_mithras
                            has_variable = oe_romp_seated_cybele
                        }
                    }
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp_ritual.6
                }
            }
        }
    }
